sourceReferences.role: Previously generated and visually inspected practical colonist clothing/material cues.
Previously generated and visually inspected vendor shirt/apron/material cues.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original eight-material base-color texture atlas for lean practical colonist characters in Athen Hill, a dusty early-2000s desert sci-fi MMO homage.
Primary request: Generate one square 2048 x 2048 pixel material atlas divided into EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, making EXACTLY EIGHT equal rectangular swatches. Each cell has width 50% and height 25% of the image. The swatches touch each other edge-to-edge with NO gutters, NO borders and NO labels. Each cell is filled entirely by its specified closeup material, no isolated objects.
Required cell order, read left to right then top to bottom:
ROW 1 LEFT: scuffed muted dark olive jacket woven cloth, subdued olive #4A513C, subtle seam-free canvas weave and worn lighter fibers.
ROW 1 RIGHT: warm tan human skin material #B88A69, natural fine pores and subtle low-contrast complexion variation, flat closeup texture only with no facial features, hairs or body shapes.
ROW 2 LEFT: dusty khaki cargo-trouser woven cloth #88785C, restrained slightly muddy fabric texture and fine worn fibers, no pockets or stitching objects.
ROW 2 RIGHT: charcoal scuffed boot leather #2D2A26, finely pebbled worn matte leather grain with subtle grey-brown scuffs.
ROW 3 LEFT: brushed worn dark gunmetal #3A4149, restrained tiny scratches and dusty dull edges represented only as subtle surface wear, no panels or hardware.
ROW 3 RIGHT: faded oxblood red work-shirt cloth #8B2E2E, fine matte weave and subtle sun-faded brown-red variation.
ROW 4 LEFT: dark brown short beard/hair texture #382920, fine short overlapping dark-brown hair fibers flowing mostly downward, continuous dense material sample with no scalp outline or facial features.
ROW 4 RIGHT: cream canvas cloth #C4B899, coarse but restrained weave and soft dusty wear, useful for garment lining or canvas details.
Style: Eight consistent, practical game base-color material samples matching a scuffed olive jacket, cargo trousers, one salvaged shoulder pad, dusty boots and a red-shirt vendor variant. Realistic but slightly soft painted early-2000s videogame texture finish. The eight cells must retain visibly different true base colors, not all become grey or brown.
Composition: Entire square is this exact 2-by-4 grid. Every rectangular cell is completely filled by its material to all four edges, with clean straight cell boundaries at x=50%, y=25%, y=50% and y=75%. No margins, gaps, borders or gutters.
Lighting: Flat, uniform, neutral unlit albedo color in every cell. No directional lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, perspective, bevel shading, metallic shine, strong highlights or photographic reflections.
Constraints: Exactly eight equal rectangular material cells in the specified order. No text, labels, letters, numerals, logos, symbols, watermark, UI, people, faces, bodies, garments, armor shapes, shoes, clothing illustration, objects, transparency or alpha. Opaque RGB atlas. Request native 2048x2048 resolution.

toolOutputHint:
Generated images are saved to /Users/carl.draper/.codex/generated_images/01a07b20-7181-7b33-9d32-43eb686efe3f as /Users/carl.draper/.codex/generated_images/01a07b20-7181-7b33-9d32-43eb686efe3f/exec-c1cfcc0e-7a6a-4e71-ac76-72da960a1cc0.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
processing: Generated PNG bytes preserved unchanged and copied to both project locations. No resampling, image editing, alpha fabrication, or provider switch.

layout.coordinateConvention: UV rectangles use top-left image origin; convert v for the runtime GLTF/Three.js convention.
layout.samplingNote: Artwork has no gutters by request. Inset UVs at least two native pixels inside each swatch boundary; boundary filtering/mipmap behavior remains a runtime validation.

review: Accepted: exact 2-column by 4-row opaque atlas; all eight rectangular swatches are filled, in the required order, with distinct meaningful base colors, flat material closeups and no labels or object illustrations. Displayed for review before workspace copies.
resolutionNote: 2048 square requested; generated source is native 1254 square. The actual returned pixels are retained without synthetic upscaling.
